messages.subject: [Traminer-users] How is SE of the mean calculated in TraMiner using weighted data?
messages.subject_clean: [Traminer-users] How is SE of the mean calculated in TraMiner using weighted data?
messages.body_plain:
Dear TraMiner Users,

I've posted a question on CrossValidated regarding how the standard-error
of the mean is calculated for the properties of sequences which have
sampling weights:

https://stats.stackexchange.com/questions/405620/how-does-the-traminer-package-calculate-standard-error-using-weighted-data


I would be very grateful for any assistance answering this question, either
directly, or in terms of references to documentation that covers this.

Many thanks in advance for any advice you are able to provide

Laurence Droy
